metadata.project_name: ClimateGuard AI - Chennai Urban Heat Risk Planner
metadata.model_component: Local Biometeorological Heat Hazard Forecast Integration

scientific_limitations_and_disclaimer.forecast_nature: Hazard scores are computed from Open-Meteo numerical weather prediction forecasts at the Chennai centroid. They are not verified ground station observations from IMD instruments.
scientific_limitations_and_disclaimer.biometeorological_scope: Indices estimate environmental thermal stress on standard human physiology in shade with light wind. They are NOT clinical health predictions or medical advice.
scientific_limitations_and_disclaimer.solar_radiation_warning: Calculations assume shaded conditions. Direct sunlight exposure can elevate perceived heat load by up to 4°C to 8°C.
